sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Seeking tenders from appropriately qualified and experienced contractors to undertake the slip repairs for the Majors Creek Mountain Road and along Araluen Road.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Slope stabilisation and reinstatement of pavements for Majors Creek Mountain Road and the 4 slips along Araluen Road as identified in the design drawings.

Refer to the RFT documents outlining the scope of works.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Mandated Scheme in Opportunity: You do NOT need to be a member of the SCM4721 Scheme to submit a tender and to be considered for this opportunity. The requirement is auto generated by the BUY.NSW website and cannot be removed.

This RFT process is being managed under the Two-Envelope system. Refer to the section Opportunity Requirements for the details.

Non-Mandatory Pre-tender meeting is proposed. Refer to the Opportunity Requirement for the details.

To lodge a response, click the RESPOND button to submit your electronic tender response. Suppliers must submit their response into the buy NSW system before 3pm on the close date. Responses can be submitted and edited multiple times until the opportunity closes, with only the most recent submission being submitted.

Don’t miss the 3pm deadline! Allow at least an hour before the tender closes to complete your submission, upload documents, and contact support if needed.

Uploading large files: The upload time depends on the supplier’s internet speed. Files are virus scanned and encrypted once uploaded. Suppliers are encouraged to upload early and wait until the upload bar completes to ensure success.

For help submitting a response, contact 1800 679 289 or buy.nsw@customerservice.nsw.gov.au.

DO NOT email your response to the primary contact as it will not be accepted.
